title: Receive files
intro: Create a receive link and share it with the sender. Files are encrypted in their browser and can only be opened in yours.
browserNoteTitle: This link's key lives in this browser
browserNoteBody: It's a one-time link that expires after 24 hours. Clearing browser data or switching device means the files can't be opened.
accountNudge: With an account the key follows you between devices, and links can be permanent.
ownerNotePlaceholder: For example: Send the signed contract here.
ownerNoteWarning: This note is not encrypted and is visible to anyone with the link.
pinLabel: Protect your key with a PIN (optional)
pinWarning: Makes it harder for someone else using this browser to decrypt your files. Not enough on a shared or public computer.
readyDescription: Share the link with the sender. Files show up on your download page as soon as they're uploaded.
keyBannerTitle: The key exists only in this browser.
keyBannerBody: Clearing browser data or switching device means the files can't be opened.
linkHint: The link isn't secret in itself, but only share it with the person who's sending.
qrLabel: QR code for the receive link
codewordsLabel: Read the words aloud to the sender, for example over the phone. If they see the same words, the files go to your key.
downloadPageHint: Keep this browser: the files can only be decrypted here. Open your download page to wait for the upload. You can also find the link again on the front page.
upsellTitle: Want to reach the files from other devices?
upsellBody: With an account the key is stored on your account, protected by your password, and links can be permanent.

errors.createFailed: Could not create a link. Try again.
errors.storageUnavailable: This browser can't save the decryption key (private browsing, or storage is blocked/full). Creating a link here would leave the key only in this tab's memory. Enable storage or use a different browser, then try again.
